messages.subject: Natural Resources Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Alexander Whitehead Team,

Your retained executive-search work across mining, natural resources and senior leadership makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG/social performance, external affairs, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder coordination.

I am internationally mobile and open to Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across mining, resources and responsible infrastructure.

My current executive CV is attached for consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
